name: Root-Crop Propagation
mechanism: Replant selected vegetative portions that retain viable growing tissue
operating_requirement: Suitable plants, healthy planting material and prepared ground
consequence: Multiply a crop without relying on seed reproduction

name: Stem-Cutting Propagation
mechanism: Induce selected stem portions to form roots
operating_requirement: Suitable species, moisture control and healthy parent material
consequence: Multiply selected plants while also carrying some parent-associated disease risks

name: Fruit-Tree Grafting
mechanism: Join compatible living tissues so a selected shoot grows on a rootstock
operating_requirement: Compatible plants, skilled workers and protected unions
consequence: Combine selected shoot traits with a different root system

name: Orchard Pruning
mechanism: Remove selected growth to manage canopy shape and fruiting structure
operating_requirement: Trained labor, tools and knowledge of the crop's growth cycle
consequence: Change light distribution and harvest access with species-dependent yield effects

name: Orchard Pollination Planning
mechanism: Place compatible flowering plants and pollinators within effective reach
operating_requirement: Flowering overlap, pollinator habitat and suitable weather
consequence: Improve fruit set where pollination is limiting

name: Vegetative-Stock Sanitation
mechanism: Separate healthy propagation sources from suspect material and track their descendants
operating_requirement: Inspected mother stocks, separate handling and records
consequence: Reduce propagation of observed disease without guaranteeing pathogen freedom

name: Seed-Dormancy Trials
mechanism: Compare treatments that release dormant seeds from different species
operating_requirement: Identified seed lots, controls and suitable trial conditions
consequence: Distinguish dormant viable seed from dead seed

name: Vernalization Trials
mechanism: Test whether a period of cold changes later flowering behavior
operating_requirement: Controlled exposure, crop observations and comparison groups
consequence: Match planting schedules to a crop's cold requirement

name: Photoperiod Crop Trials
mechanism: Compare flowering and growth under different day lengths
operating_requirement: Recorded light periods and comparable crop conditions
consequence: Identify varieties suited to a region's seasonal light cycle

name: Hybrid Seed Production
mechanism: Maintain selected parent lines and cross them to produce a defined hybrid generation
operating_requirement: Isolated parents, controlled pollen transfer and quality checks
consequence: Supply hybrid seed while retaining dependence on maintained parent lines

name: Seed-Lot Identity
mechanism: Preserve the identity and provenance of seed through storage and distribution
operating_requirement: Labeled containers, custody records and separate handling
consequence: Trace mixed or unsuitable seed to its source

name: Seed Banks
mechanism: Preserve diverse seed accessions and periodically test viability
operating_requirement: Suitable storage, regeneration plots and curators
consequence: Retain recoverable crop diversity with finite storage and regeneration costs

name: Raised-Bed Cultivation
mechanism: Elevate growing soil above surrounding paths or waterlogged ground
operating_requirement: Earthmoving labor, soil and maintained drainage
consequence: Improve root-zone drainage while increasing construction and watering needs

name: Terrace Cultivation
mechanism: Create supported level growing surfaces on sloping land
operating_requirement: Retaining structures, drains and continuing maintenance
consequence: Reduce slope runoff while introducing failure risks and construction costs

name: Flood-Recession Farming
mechanism: Plant into moist exposed ground after predictable inundation recedes
operating_requirement: Suitable floodplain, timing knowledge and access to recession land
consequence: Use retained moisture while remaining exposed to flood timing uncertainty

name: Relay Cropping
mechanism: Establish a following crop before the previous crop is fully removed
operating_requirement: Compatible crop timing, labor and adequate water
consequence: Overlap growing periods while increasing competition and harvest complexity

name: Mixed-Species Cropping
mechanism: Grow complementary species together and compare their joint performance
operating_requirement: Compatible plants, spatial planning and separate harvest methods
consequence: Diversify output with context-dependent competition and labor costs

name: Draft Ploughing
mechanism: Use trained draft animals to pull a soil-working implement
operating_requirement: Animals, harness, implement and feed
consequence: Increase worked area where soil and traction permit

name: Mouldboard Ploughs
mechanism: Lift and turn a soil slice with a shaped working surface
operating_requirement: Suitable metalwork, traction and replaceable wearing parts
consequence: Bury surface residues while increasing disturbance and draft demand

name: Field Harrowing
mechanism: Break clods and level the seedbed with repeated shallow soil contact
operating_requirement: Harrow, traction and suitable soil moisture
consequence: Prepare a finer seedbed at added labor and soil disturbance

name: Mechanical Seed Drills
mechanism: Meter seed into prepared rows at a controlled rate and depth
operating_requirement: Metering mechanism, openers, traction and calibrated seed supply
consequence: Reduce placement variation without removing soil and crop constraints

name: Threshing Frames
mechanism: Separate grain from harvested heads through repeated mechanical impact or rubbing
operating_requirement: Harvested crop, working surface and labor
consequence: Recover grain while risking breakage and contamination if poorly operated

name: Winnowing Practice
mechanism: Use differences in aerodynamic behavior to separate grain from lighter residues
operating_requirement: Suitable airflow, containers and repeated handling
consequence: Clean threshed grain while losing some material

name: Mechanical Reapers
mechanism: Drive a cutting mechanism across standing crops
operating_requirement: Traction, cutters, maintenance and suitable crop conditions
consequence: Reduce cutting labor while requiring coordinated collection

name: Combine Harvesters
mechanism: Combine cutting, threshing and separation on one mobile machine
operating_requirement: Propulsion, calibrated mechanisms, fuel and repair capacity
consequence: Reduce harvest handling steps within crop and terrain limits

name: Grain-Moisture Testing
mechanism: Estimate grain water content using a calibrated comparison method
operating_requirement: Representative sampling and calibrated instruments
consequence: Distinguish grain suitable for storage from grain needing drying

name: Forced-Air Grain Drying
mechanism: Pass controlled airflow through grain to remove moisture
operating_requirement: Fans, energy, air passages and monitoring
consequence: Dry harvests faster while consuming energy and risking uneven treatment

name: Roller Grain Milling
mechanism: Pass grain through adjustable rollers to control size reduction
operating_requirement: Rollers, drive power and measured gaps
consequence: Produce controlled fractions with machinery and maintenance costs

name: Flour Sifting
mechanism: Separate milled particles through meshes of defined opening size
operating_requirement: Screens, labor or drive power and clean handling
consequence: Produce selected flour fractions while retaining separated bran and coarse material

name: Grain Malting
mechanism: Allow controlled germination before arresting growth by drying
operating_requirement: Suitable grain, moisture, temperature and drying capacity
consequence: Develop useful grain enzymes while consuming some stored reserves

name: Dough Leavening
mechanism: Retain fermentation gases within a prepared dough structure
operating_requirement: Flour, water, a maintained ferment and suitable conditions
consequence: Change texture and processing time without increasing available food mass

name: Controlled Baking
mechanism: Apply a repeatable heating schedule to prepared food
operating_requirement: Oven, fuel, monitoring and trained operators
consequence: Produce more consistent cooked food with fuel and moisture losses

name: Edible-Oil Clarification
mechanism: Remove suspended solids and unwanted entrained moisture from a suitable expressed food oil using controlled settling and filtration
operating_requirement: Food-suitable oil, clean settling vessels, filtration media and quality checks
consequence: Produce clarified oil and separated residues without repeating the oil-pressing discovery

name: Oil Rancidity Management
mechanism: Limit exposure and conditions that accelerate deterioration of stored oil
operating_requirement: Suitable containers, temperature control and stock rotation
consequence: Extend usable storage under specified conditions

name: Food Freezing
mechanism: Remove heat until food water partly freezes and maintain frozen storage
operating_requirement: Freezing equipment, continuous energy and suitable packaging
consequence: Slow deterioration while introducing a continuing cold-chain dependency

name: Freeze Drying
mechanism: Remove frozen water by sublimation under controlled reduced pressure
operating_requirement: Vacuum, refrigeration, heat input and moisture-resistant packaging
consequence: Produce lightweight preserved food at high energy and equipment cost

name: Controlled-Atmosphere Food Storage
mechanism: Maintain a crop-appropriate gas mixture around stored produce
operating_requirement: Sealed storage, gas control, monitoring and temperature management
consequence: Slow selected deterioration processes within crop-specific limits

name: Food-Batch Traceability
mechanism: Record ingredient sources, processing batches and destinations
operating_requirement: Identified lots and reliable handling records
consequence: Locate implicated goods without recalling every unrelated batch

name: Food-Process Hazard Analysis
mechanism: Identify process stages where failure can create a food hazard and define monitored controls
operating_requirement: Qualified analysis, validated controls and operating records
consequence: Target prevention at specified failure points rather than trusting final appearance

name: Selective Herd Breeding
mechanism: Choose breeding animals using recorded inherited performance
operating_requirement: Identified animals, controlled mating and sufficient breeding diversity
consequence: Shift herd traits over generations with inbreeding and environment constraints

name: Livestock Feed Rations
mechanism: Combine feed sources against measured animal needs and performance
operating_requirement: Feed analysis, weighing and available ingredients
consequence: Improve feeding consistency while preserving finite feed requirements

name: Haymaking
mechanism: Dry cut forage for use outside the growing season
operating_requirement: Suitable weather, cutting labor and protected storage
consequence: Carry part of seasonal forage into later feed demand

name: Forage Silage
mechanism: Preserve suitable moist forage through controlled oxygen-limited fermentation
operating_requirement: Harvested forage, compacted sealed storage and monitoring
consequence: Store forage when drying conditions are poor

name: Rotational Grazing Plans
mechanism: Move livestock among grazing areas according to measured forage recovery
operating_requirement: Fencing or herders, water points and adequate land
consequence: Manage grazing pressure without assuming rotation alone increases carrying capacity

name: Stock Watering Points
mechanism: Provide accessible water suited to herd demand
operating_requirement: Water supply, troughs and maintenance
consequence: Support herd distribution while concentrating local trampling and waste

name: Clean Milk Handling
mechanism: Keep collected milk apart from dirty surfaces and unsuitable storage conditions
operating_requirement: Clean equipment, water, trained handlers and timely cooling or processing
consequence: Reduce contamination opportunities without rendering milk automatically safe

name: Cheese Curd Processing
mechanism: Coagulate suitable milk and separate curd from whey
operating_requirement: Controlled culture or coagulant, clean vessels and temperature management
consequence: Produce curd and whey as distinct food streams

name: Butter Churning
mechanism: Agitate cream until fat coalesces and separates from the liquid phase
operating_requirement: Suitable cream, churn and clean handling
consequence: Produce butter and a remaining liquid food stream

name: Poultry Brooding
mechanism: Maintain conditions for egg incubation and early chick survival
operating_requirement: Suitable eggs, warmth, ventilation, feed and care
consequence: Raise young birds while consuming feed and care capacity

name: Pond Aquaculture
mechanism: Manage aquatic stock and feeding within a retained water body
operating_requirement: Suitable species, water, feed and harvest management
consequence: Produce aquatic food subject to oxygen, waste and disease constraints

name: Fish Hatchery Practice
mechanism: Manage spawning and early aquatic life stages separately from grow-out
operating_requirement: Species-specific facilities, water quality and trained staff
consequence: Supply juvenile stock while retaining biological survival limits

name: Recirculating Aquaculture
mechanism: Treat and reuse culture water while removing solids and metabolic waste
operating_requirement: Pumps, filters, oxygen supply, energy and monitoring
consequence: Reduce water replacement at increased equipment and failure dependence

name: Integrated Aquaponics
mechanism: Link aquatic waste treatment with plant nutrient uptake under controlled loading
operating_requirement: Compatible species, balanced nutrient flows and water treatment
consequence: Recover some nutrients without assuming fish and crop needs automatically match

name: Greenhouse Climate Control
mechanism: Regulate enclosed crop temperature, ventilation and humidity
operating_requirement: Enclosure, actuators, energy and environmental sensors
consequence: Extend controlled growing conditions at material and energy cost

name: Soilless Nutrient Culture
mechanism: Supply dissolved nutrients to roots in a monitored solution or inert substrate
operating_requirement: Balanced nutrients, clean water, oxygenation and monitoring
consequence: Grow crops apart from field soil while depending on managed inputs

name: Crop Light Schedules
mechanism: Supply measured supplemental light according to crop response and growth stage
operating_requirement: Suitable lamps, electricity and thermal management
consequence: Extend or alter crop light exposure with substantial energy demand

name: Closed Crop-Water Loops
mechanism: Recover and treat crop drainage and transpired moisture for reuse
operating_requirement: Collection surfaces, treatment, pumps and contamination control
consequence: Reduce external water demand while retaining losses and treatment waste

name: Multilayer Indoor Cultivation
mechanism: Stack controlled growing surfaces with managed light and nutrient delivery
operating_requirement: Racks, lighting, climate control and reliable maintenance
consequence: Increase output per ground footprint at high infrastructure and power cost

name: Crop Robotic Handling
mechanism: Use sensed crop position and condition to guide bounded handling tasks
operating_requirement: Validated machines, suitable crop geometry and maintenance
consequence: Automate selected labor while unfamiliar crops or terrain remain difficult

name: Habitat Food Balance
mechanism: Balance crop output, dietary needs, residues and resupply within a habitat
operating_requirement: Diverse production, measured inventories and qualified planners
consequence: Expose nutritional and material deficits that a calorie total alone misses

name: Watershed Boundary Surveys
mechanism: Map terrain directing runoff toward a common outlet
operating_requirement: Surveyors, elevation observations and field verification
consequence: Identify upstream land influencing a water source

name: Spring Capture Structures
mechanism: Collect emerging groundwater while excluding surface runoff
operating_requirement: Suitable spring, protected intake and maintenance
consequence: Make a local source usable without increasing its recharge

name: Well Lining
mechanism: Support a well shaft and separate it from unstable adjacent material
operating_requirement: Suitable lining, skilled construction and inspection
consequence: Reduce collapse and some ingress paths

name: Bucket Windlasses
mechanism: Wind a lifting line around a rotating drum
operating_requirement: Drum, bearings, rope and human or animal work
consequence: Lift water while retaining finite payload and labor requirements

name: Counterweighted Water Lifts
mechanism: Use a counterweight to assist repeated lifting of a water vessel
operating_requirement: Pivot, weight, vessel and operator
consequence: Reduce peak lifting effort at limited reach

name: Chain-of-Pots Water Lifts
mechanism: Move a continuous series of containers between water and discharge levels
operating_requirement: Drive, chain or rope, containers and maintenance
consequence: Lift a steady flow at a finite work cost

name: Water-Lifting Screws
mechanism: Trap and raise water within a rotating helical passage
operating_requirement: Inclined screw, trough and drive
consequence: Move water across a modest lift with leakage and friction losses

name: Gravity Aqueducts
mechanism: Carry water along a controlled downhill gradient
operating_requirement: Surveyed route, channel structures and upkeep
consequence: Deliver water without continuous pumping where topography permits

name: Siphon Crossings
mechanism: Carry a full pressure conduit down and up across a depression
operating_requirement: Adequate upstream head, rated pipes and air management
consequence: Cross terrain while incurring pressure and friction constraints

name: Qanat Gallery Construction
mechanism: Excavate a gently graded underground gallery to drain an aquifer toward an outlet
operating_requirement: Suitable geology, skilled diggers, access shafts and maintenance
consequence: Deliver groundwater by gravity while limited by recharge and safe excavation

name: Distribution Reservoirs
mechanism: Hold delivered water before distributing it to users
operating_requirement: Storage volume, protected inlet and controlled outlets
consequence: Buffer variation between arrival and demand

name: Water Pressure Zones
mechanism: Divide a network into areas operating within suitable pressure ranges
operating_requirement: Valves, storage elevations and pressure measurements
consequence: Limit excessive pressure and low-service areas

name: Water-Main Isolation
mechanism: Section a network so damaged parts can be disconnected
operating_requirement: Accessible valves and accurate network records
consequence: Permit repair while retaining some unaffected supply

name: Water-Leak Balances
mechanism: Compare measured network inflows, storage changes and delivered outflows
operating_requirement: Meters, synchronized records and representative measurements
consequence: Reveal unexplained water losses without locating every leak

name: Acoustic Leak Detection
mechanism: Locate candidate leaks from their vibration or sound signatures
operating_requirement: Sensors, trained interpretation and accessible infrastructure
consequence: Target inspection while producing ambiguous signals in noisy conditions

name: Water-Meter Calibration
mechanism: Compare meter response against a controlled reference flow
operating_requirement: Reference apparatus, trained staff and calibration records
consequence: Reduce systematic error in delivered-water accounts

name: Backflow Prevention
mechanism: Interrupt reverse flow from a potentially contaminated connection
operating_requirement: Suitable devices, separation and periodic testing
consequence: Reduce cross-contamination paths under specified pressure conditions

name: Cross-Connection Inspection
mechanism: Identify physical links between potable and incompatible water systems
operating_requirement: Accurate plans, field inspections and corrective authority
consequence: Remove hidden contamination pathways

name: Water-Source Protection Zones
mechanism: Restrict specified upstream activities around a vulnerable source
operating_requirement: Source assessment, monitoring and enforceable land-use rules
consequence: Reduce defined source risks while imposing limits on other land uses

name: Raw-Water Quality Sampling
mechanism: Collect representative water observations across places and seasons
operating_requirement: Clean sampling equipment, laboratories and a sampling plan
consequence: Characterize variation rather than relying on one favorable sample

name: Water-Turbidity Measurement
mechanism: Compare scattering of light by suspended material
operating_requirement: Calibrated instruments and representative samples
consequence: Track particle-related changes without equating clarity with safety

name: Coagulation and Flocculation
mechanism: Destabilize suitable suspended particles and promote larger settling aggregates
operating_requirement: Qualified treatment chemistry, mixing and controlled trials
consequence: Improve removal of selected particles while creating treatment sludge

name: Rapid Granular Filtration
mechanism: Pass prepared water through granular media with periodic cleaning
operating_requirement: Filter beds, hydraulic control and backwash capacity
consequence: Treat larger flows while requiring pretreatment and maintenance

name: Filter Backwashing
mechanism: Reverse or agitate flow to remove retained solids from a suitable filter
operating_requirement: Clean wash water, valves and waste handling
consequence: Restore filter performance while consuming water and producing waste

name: Water Disinfection Control
mechanism: Apply and verify a validated microbial inactivation process
operating_requirement: Qualified process, monitoring and trained operators
consequence: Reduce specified microbial hazards while leaving some chemical hazards unchanged

name: Chlorinated Water Treatment
mechanism: Use a controlled disinfectant process with measured contact and residual conditions
operating_requirement: Qualified dosing equipment, reagents and water-quality controls
consequence: Provide validated treatment and residual protection within process limits

name: Ultraviolet Water Treatment
mechanism: Expose suitably clear water to a monitored ultraviolet treatment field
operating_requirement: Qualified lamps, power, flow control and maintenance
consequence: Inactivate susceptible organisms without leaving a persistent disinfectant residual

name: Ozone Water Treatment
mechanism: Generate and contact water with an oxidizing gas under controlled conditions
operating_requirement: Gas-generation equipment, containment and process monitoring
consequence: Treat selected hazards while consuming power and requiring byproduct control

name: Membrane Microfiltration
mechanism: Pass water through controlled pores that retain larger particles
operating_requirement: Qualified membranes, pressure and cleaning systems
consequence: Remove specified size classes while producing a concentrated waste stream

name: Water Ultrafiltration
mechanism: Use finer membrane separation for selected colloids and macromolecules
operating_requirement: Appropriate membranes, pressure and integrity testing
consequence: Reject smaller suspended constituents within membrane performance limits

name: Reverse-Osmosis Desalination
mechanism: Apply pressure to separate water from dissolved salts across a selective membrane
operating_requirement: Qualified membranes, high-pressure pumps, pretreatment and energy
consequence: Produce lower-salinity water and concentrated brine

name: Thermal Desalination
mechanism: Evaporate and condense water while separating most dissolved salts
operating_requirement: Heat, condensers, corrosion control and brine disposal
consequence: Produce water at substantial heat and equipment cost

name: Desalination Energy Recovery
mechanism: Transfer part of pressurized reject-flow energy to the incoming stream
operating_requirement: Pressure-exchange equipment and compatible flow control
consequence: Reduce purchased work without eliminating desalination energy demand

name: Brine Discharge Management
mechanism: Manage concentrated reject flows against receiving-environment capacity
operating_requirement: Discharge assessment, infrastructure and monitoring
consequence: Limit selected local impacts while preserving the waste mass balance

name: Rainwater First-Flush Diversion
mechanism: Separate an initial runoff fraction carrying accumulated roof or catchment material
operating_requirement: Diverters, maintained surfaces and storage
consequence: Reduce some incoming contaminants without making collected water automatically potable

name: Stormwater Detention
mechanism: Temporarily retain runoff and release it at a controlled rate
operating_requirement: Storage space, outlets and maintained overflow paths
consequence: Reduce peak downstream discharge within design capacity

name: Infiltration Basins
mechanism: Hold suitable water over permeable ground to allow controlled infiltration
operating_requirement: Suitable soils, pretreatment and groundwater protection
consequence: Reduce surface runoff or support recharge with clogging and contamination constraints

name: Managed Aquifer Recharge
mechanism: Introduce suitable water into an assessed aquifer and track its recovery
operating_requirement: Hydrogeologic evidence, recharge works and monitoring
consequence: Store some water underground while retaining quality and recoverability uncertainty

name: Drought Supply Planning
mechanism: Plan staged demand and supply actions against uncertain future inflow
operating_requirement: Water inventories, forecasts and adopted priorities
consequence: Extend usable reserves through explicit restrictions and costs

name: Separate Storm Sewers
mechanism: Keep storm runoff out of a separately collected sanitary wastewater stream
operating_requirement: Separate networks, maintained connections and outfalls
consequence: Reduce some treatment surges while retaining runoff pollution

name: Sewage Lift Stations
mechanism: Pump collected wastewater across an unavoidable rise
operating_requirement: Pumps, screens, power and overflow contingencies
consequence: Extend collection where gravity alone is insufficient

name: Wastewater Screening
mechanism: Intercept large solids before they damage downstream treatment equipment
operating_requirement: Screens, handling labor and removed-waste disposal
consequence: Protect equipment without treating dissolved or fine contaminants

name: Primary Wastewater Settling
mechanism: Retain wastewater long enough for selected solids to settle or float
operating_requirement: Tanks, flow control and sludge removal
consequence: Separate part of the solid load before further treatment

name: Biological Wastewater Filters
mechanism: Support microbial treatment on a supplied fixed surface
operating_requirement: Media, oxygen, controlled loading and maintenance
consequence: Reduce biodegradable loads while producing biomass and residual waste

name: Activated-Sludge Treatment
mechanism: Maintain and recycle an aerated microbial suspension that consumes biodegradable matter
operating_requirement: Aeration, settling, trained operation and biomass control
consequence: Treat wastewater at sustained energy and operating cost

name: Wastewater Nutrient Removal
mechanism: Use controlled treatment stages to remove selected nitrogen and phosphorus compounds
operating_requirement: Appropriate reactors, monitoring and sludge management
consequence: Reduce nutrient discharge within a validated process envelope

name: Sludge Digesters
mechanism: Stabilize suitable concentrated organic residuals through controlled digestion
operating_requirement: Contained reactors, temperature management and gas handling
consequence: Produce stabilized residuals and recoverable gas with remaining disposal needs

name: Biosolids Quality Control
mechanism: Characterize treated residuals before permitting a proposed use
operating_requirement: Sampling, contaminant testing and enforceable use limits
consequence: Prevent treating every recovered solid as suitable fertilizer

name: Constructed Treatment Wetlands
mechanism: Route pretreated water through a designed planted treatment bed
operating_requirement: Land, suitable substrate, controlled loading and maintenance
consequence: Provide lower-intensity treatment with land and seasonal constraints

name: Decentralized Sanitation Services
mechanism: Organize local containment, emptying and treatment where sewers are absent
operating_requirement: Service crews, transport and safe treatment destinations
consequence: Provide sanitation without assuming a central sewer network

name: Fecal-Sludge Collection
mechanism: Remove contained waste and transport it to a managed treatment location
operating_requirement: Suitable equipment, workers and receiving capacity
consequence: Prevent containment from becoming indefinite unserviced accumulation

name: Greywater Reuse

consequence: Reduce freshwater demand while retaining exposure restrictions

name: Potable-Reuse Barriers

operating_requirement: Validated processes, continuous monitoring and diversion capability
consequence: Produce acceptable water only while all required barriers operate

name: Water-Treatment Fail-Safe Diversion
mechanism: Divert or halt delivery when monitored treatment conditions leave their validated range
operating_requirement: Reliable sensing, isolation and reserve supply
consequence: Avoid counting untreated output as compliant water during failure

name: Water-Network Telemetry
mechanism: Transmit measured flow, pressure and condition from connected sites
operating_requirement: Sensors, actual communication links, power and maintenance
consequence: Improve awareness with delay, coverage and sensor-error limits

name: Water-Demand Forecasts
mechanism: Estimate future demand from observed use and changing conditions
operating_requirement: Representative data and regularly updated models
consequence: Support capacity planning without promising a fixed future demand

name: Water-Energy Joint Dispatch
mechanism: Schedule pumping and storage around water service and energy constraints
operating_requirement: Controllable pumps, storage and coordinated operators
consequence: Trade pumping time against available reserve and electricity cost

name: Habitat Water-Quality Barriers
mechanism: Verify recycled habitat water through independent monitored barriers
operating_requirement: Qualified treatment, spare parts and contingency inventory
consequence: Preserve potable supply while exposing finite recovery losses

name: Water-Service Recovery Drills
mechanism: Rehearse restoring safe service after loss of a source or treatment stage
operating_requirement: Operators, reserve plans and realistic exercises
consequence: Reveal missing recovery capacity before a real interruption

name: Habitat Observation Records
mechanism: Record organisms alongside the places and seasonal conditions where they occur
operating_requirement: Observers, repeatable descriptions and retained records

name: Ecological Transects
mechanism: Observe organisms or ground cover along repeatable sampled lines

name: Vegetation Quadrats
mechanism: Measure vegetation within defined sample areas
operating_requirement: Sample frames, identification skill and representative placement

name: Wildlife Track Surveys
mechanism: Record repeatable signs of animal passage and activity
operating_requirement: Trained observers and suitable substrate or observation conditions

name: Seasonal Wildlife Calendars
mechanism: Compare recurring breeding, migration and feeding periods
operating_requirement: Repeated observations and retained dates

name: Population Mark-Recapture

name: Ecological Detection Models

name: Forest Inventory Plots

name: Forest Growth-and-Yield Models

name: Selective Tree Harvesting
mechanism: Remove specified trees while retaining chosen stand structure

name: Coppice Woodland Management

name: Pollard Fodder Management

name: Forest Seed-Source Matching

name: Forest Nursery Practice

name: Reforestation Site Preparation

name: Assisted Natural Regeneration

name: Woodland Harvest Rotations

name: Forest Access-Impact Planning

operating_requirement: Route surveys, harvest plans and operating supervision

name: Fuel-Load Surveys

name: Landscape Firebreaks

name: Prescribed-Fire Planning

mechanism: Identify and treat exposed areas most likely to shed damaging runoff or sediment
operating_requirement: Rapid surveys, suitable materials and maintenance
consequence: Reduce selected erosion risks while natural recovery proceeds

name: Riparian Buffer Management
mechanism: Retain or restore vegetation beside waterways with suitable width and continuity
operating_requirement: Land access, site-specific planting and protection
consequence: Intercept some runoff and retain habitat without filtering every pollutant

name: Stream-Bank Bioengineering
mechanism: Combine living vegetation with structural elements suited to bank forces
operating_requirement: Hydraulic assessment, plant material and maintenance
consequence: Stabilize selected banks while preserving some ecological function

name: Wetland Hydrology Restoration
mechanism: Restore appropriate water timing and connectivity to a degraded wetland
operating_requirement: Hydrologic assessment, land agreements and control structures
consequence: Support wetland recovery where water and propagules are available

name: Floodplain Reconnection
mechanism: Restore defined exchanges between a river and its floodplain
operating_requirement: Flood-risk planning, land access and altered barriers
consequence: Recover storage and habitat while changing local inundation exposure

name: Fish Passage Design
mechanism: Provide a route past an artificial obstacle suited to target species
operating_requirement: Hydraulic design, suitable flow and monitoring
consequence: Restore some movement without guaranteeing passage for every organism

name: Stream Environmental Flows
mechanism: Reserve a specified flow regime for ecological functions
operating_requirement: Hydrologic records, competing-user agreements and monitoring
consequence: Constrain withdrawals to retain selected river processes

name: Sediment Budget Accounts
mechanism: Track sources, storage and movement of sediment through a catchment
operating_requirement: Sampling, surveys and repeatable estimates
consequence: Identify interventions that move rather than solve erosion problems

name: Gully-Erosion Control
mechanism: Reduce concentrated runoff energy and stabilize active erosion channels
operating_requirement: Catchment treatment, suitable structures and upkeep
consequence: Limit gully expansion within design and flow constraints

name: Wind-Erosion Shelterbelts
mechanism: Place vegetation to reduce near-ground wind over vulnerable soil
operating_requirement: Land, suitable species and establishment care
consequence: Reduce some wind erosion while consuming growing space and water

name: Saline-Soil Reclamation
mechanism: Manage salt movement through a assessed soil-water system
operating_requirement: Suitable water, drainage and disposal of mobilized salts
consequence: Recover some productive capacity without making salts disappear

name: Soil Organic-Matter Accounts
mechanism: Track additions, decomposition and removal of soil organic material
operating_requirement: Representative measurements and management records
consequence: Distinguish temporary residue inputs from retained soil change

name: Soil-Compaction Diagnosis
mechanism: Compare resistance, pore behavior and root restriction after loading
operating_requirement: Sampling, instruments and knowledge of moisture conditions
consequence: Target traffic or remediation instead of assuming all dense soil is damaged

name: Controlled-Traffic Farming
mechanism: Confine repeated machinery loads to designated paths
operating_requirement: Compatible machinery widths, guidance and maintained lanes
consequence: Reduce repeated compaction over the remaining growing area

name: Agroforestry Design
mechanism: Combine trees and agricultural uses with managed spatial and temporal interaction
operating_requirement: Compatible species, land planning and long-term maintenance
consequence: Diversify outputs while managing competition for light, water and labor

name: Pollinator Habitat Networks
mechanism: Maintain connected nesting and forage opportunities for suitable pollinators
operating_requirement: Habitat area, compatible vegetation and disturbance control
consequence: Support pollination capacity where habitat is limiting

name: Integrated Pest Monitoring
mechanism: Track crop damage, pest presence and beneficial organisms before choosing interventions
operating_requirement: Trained scouts, identification and repeated records
consequence: Replace routine action with evidence of current conditions

name: Pest Action Thresholds
mechanism: Compare expected damage and intervention costs under explicit ecological constraints
operating_requirement: Local evidence, uncertainty estimates and available responses
consequence: Avoid some unnecessary interventions without guaranteeing zero crop loss

name: Biological Pest Control
mechanism: Use assessed natural enemies to suppress a target pest
operating_requirement: Species-specific evidence, containment where needed and monitoring
consequence: Reduce target pressure while retaining non-target and establishment risks

name: Crop-Pest Exclusion
mechanism: Separate vulnerable crops from selected pests using physical barriers
operating_requirement: Suitable mesh or structures and access management
consequence: Reduce entry while changing ventilation, pollination and labor demands

name: Invasive-Species Screening
mechanism: Assess introduced organisms and associated material for specified establishment risks
operating_requirement: Identification expertise, inspection and evidence of local susceptibility
consequence: Reduce some introductions without detecting every hidden organism

name: Invasive-Species Early Detection
mechanism: Survey likely entry and establishment sites with a defined detection strategy
operating_requirement: Observers, diagnostic support and reporting
consequence: Find some introductions while populations may still be localized

name: Invasive-Species Response Plans
mechanism: Prepare authorized containment or removal actions for a detected introduction
operating_requirement: Trained crews, resources and species-specific methods
consequence: Act earlier while success remains uncertain and context dependent

name: Habitat Corridor Planning
mechanism: Retain or restore connections that target organisms can actually traverse
operating_requirement: Land agreements, species evidence and monitoring
consequence: Reduce some isolation while potentially transmitting disease or invasive species

name: Protected-Area Zoning
mechanism: Assign different permitted activities within a conservation area
operating_requirement: Ecological evidence, affected-community participation and enforcement
consequence: Manage pressures while making access and livelihood tradeoffs explicit

name: Community Resource Monitoring
mechanism: Train and support local users to record agreed resource conditions
operating_requirement: Shared methods, equipment and credible reporting
consequence: Broaden observations while requiring trust and quality control

name: Biodiversity Reference Sites
mechanism: Maintain comparison locations for observing ecological change
operating_requirement: Long-term access, documentation and sampling continuity
consequence: Distinguish some intervention effects from broader background changes

name: Ecological Restoration Targets
mechanism: Define measurable recovery objectives and acceptable uncertainty
operating_requirement: Reference evidence, stakeholders and monitoring plans
consequence: Make restoration success assessable without assuming one timeless natural state

name: Adaptive Land Management
mechanism: Update management from monitored outcomes using explicit decision rules
operating_requirement: Continuing measurements, authority and capacity to change practice
consequence: Learn from interventions rather than repeating a fixed prescription

name: Landscape Remote Sensing
mechanism: Interpret spatially extensive measurements taken from a remote platform
operating_requirement: Sensors, georeferencing and field checks
consequence: Map change over larger areas while retaining classification uncertainty

name: Ecological Change Detection
mechanism: Compare compatible observations through time while separating noise from change
operating_requirement: Calibrated data, reference samples and analysts
consequence: Identify candidate change areas rather than assuming every pixel difference is real

name: Forest Carbon Measurement
mechanism: Estimate carbon in biomass and soils with defined boundaries and uncertainty
operating_requirement: Field measurements, appropriate models and repeated inventories
consequence: Track retained carbon without treating a planting promise as stored carbon

name: Conservation Genetic Sampling
mechanism: Collect representative identified biological samples for later diversity analysis
operating_requirement: Qualified collection, preservation and traceable records
consequence: Enable genetic assessment without itself supplying a sequencing method

name: Assisted Species-Movement Review
mechanism: Assess proposed relocation against climate suitability and recipient-ecosystem risks
operating_requirement: Evidence, authorization and long-term monitoring
consequence: Permit or reject a bounded relocation rather than assuming movement is always beneficial

name: Urban Heat Ecology
mechanism: Measure interactions among surfaces, vegetation, shade and local temperatures
operating_requirement: Spatial observations and site-specific trials
consequence: Target heat reduction while accounting for water and maintenance needs

name: Green-Infrastructure Networks
mechanism: Connect vegetated urban systems around measured cooling, drainage and habitat functions
operating_requirement: Land, engineering, planting and continuing stewardship
consequence: Combine selected functions without counting each benefit independently of shared limits

name: Closed-Ecosystem Experiments
mechanism: Observe material cycling and biological stability within a bounded experimental system
operating_requirement: Containment, sensors, controls and recoverable intervention capacity
consequence: Test closure assumptions rather than declaring self-sufficiency from short survival

name: Artificial-Habitat Ecology
mechanism: Design managed biological communities around measured habitat service needs
operating_requirement: Qualified organisms, controlled conditions and ongoing care
consequence: Support selected recycling or habitat functions with residual inputs and waste

name: Long-Duration Ecological Stewardship
mechanism: Maintain responsibility, observations and resources for ecological work across generations
operating_requirement: Durable institutions, funding and transferable local knowledge
consequence: Sustain stewardship without assuming future staff or resources are guaranteed
